svg.title: The tender room, five past two
svg.desc: A port tender room with a 340-page document, a highlighted clause, three bid summaries and a whiteboard with one noun phrase broken into brackets.

g.text: The tender room, five past two
Twelve things to find. Three of them are the same requirement, priced three ways.
the stacking yard, beyond the window
the whiteboard, one phrase in brackets
Saskia - she signed the tender off
Gunnar - bid manager, six per cent of margin
the ruler, used as a pointer
the diagram, with one word circled
the box of highlighters, all dead
